tasks.label: Auto Sync Reminder
args: while($true) { Start-Sleep 600; Write-Host '⚠️ HATIRLATMA: Export senkronizasyonu yapmayı unutma! (npm run sync-export)' -ForegroundColor Yellow; [console]::beep(800,300) }

tasks.label: Show Critical TODOs
args: Write-Host '🚨🚨🚨 KRİTİK GÖREVLER (SONRAKİ OTURUM) 🚨🚨🚨' -ForegroundColor Red -BackgroundColor White; Get-Content TODO.md -Head 35 | Select-String -Pattern '🚨','\[ \]','\*\*' | ForEach-Object { Write-Host $_ -ForegroundColor Yellow }; Write-Host '---------------------------------------------------' -ForegroundColor Red
